speaker: Mr Abdul Muhaimin Abdul Malik (Sengkang)
text: I have two supplementary questions for Minister of State Goh: first, whether the Ministry has engaged social service agencies or family service centres to gather feedback on how current eligibility criteria affect caregiving households.

speaker: Mr Abdul Muhaimin Abdul Malik (Sengkang)
text: And number question two, whether the Ministry can share a timeline for any planned review of subsidy eligibility frameworks affecting young families.
